scope: Actual bounded model adapter calls using synthetic fixtures. Pure participant-confirmation/planning pipeline; not managed multi-account browser, usability, payment or market proof.

rates.policy: Reserve UTF-8 bytes of full request plus 512 input tokens and all 1400 allowed output tokens before every dispatch. No caching discount assumed. No retries. This is a conservative allowance, not an account invoice.
